text:
Harry Kane has broken the record for the most senior England caps by a single player in history.
The Three Lions captain leads the line for Thursday's Nations League clash against Croatia, making his 126th appearance for his country in the process.
He bypasses the record previously held by goalkeeper Peter Shilton, who earned 125 caps between 1970 and 1990.
Shilton will make a presentation to the England skipper on the pitch ahead of kick-off at Wembley.

The 33-year-old Kane had equalled Shilton's record on October 6, when he scored twice in a 3-0 win over the Czech Republic at Wembley.

          Harry Kane said winning this year's Ballon d'Or was 'beyond his wildest dreams' and was happy to put England 'back on the map' by being the first Englishman to win the trophy in 25 years
        
      
    
The history-making moment comes less than three weeks after Kane was crowned the first English Ballon d'Or winner in 25 years.
Kane is also England's highest scorer of all time, having scored 91 goals to date.
Looking at his stats across 25-appearance blocks since his debut in March 2015, the striker's finishing has improved over time.

Across the 25 matches prior to his record-breaking appearance, Kane hit 43 shots on target and scored 23 goals, with a shooting accuracy of 55.8 per cent and a conversion rate of 29.9 per cent.
All four metrics were at their highest across any 25-game block to date.
digest_he:
חלוץ נבחרת אנגליה, הארי קיין, שבר את השיא ההיסטורי והפך לשחקן בעל מספר ההופעות הרב ביותר במדים הלאומיים עם 126 הופעות בסך הכול. קיין עקף את שיא ההופעות הקודם שהוחזק על ידי השוער המיתולוגי פיטר שילטון מאז שנת 1990.

הישג היסטורי זה מגיע זמן קצר לאחר שקיין זכה בתואר כדור הזהב והפך לשחקן האנגלי הראשון שזוכה בפרס היוקרתי מזה 25 שנים. קיין מחזיק גם בשיא כיבוש השערים בכל הזמנים של הנבחרת האנגלית, עם מאזן מרשים של 91 שערים.
